findings: The retry plan sets a not-before time and attempt limit but omits the required no-later-than deadline of 2026-08-29T20:20:00.000Z. An attempt count alone does not ensure retries or escalation occur within the policy's bounded window after the west mismatch.
summary: Preserving the unpublished release and retrying for a matching west confirmation are supported, but the retry plan needs an explicit latest retry/escalation deadline.
